corrections.old_text: ናልና ፡ ም ፡ ፳ ፡ ፴ ። ገላት ፡ ፪ ፡ ፬ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ናልና ፡ ም ፡ ፳ ፡ ፴ ። ገላት ፡ ፪ ፡ ፫ ።
corrections.reason: The cross-reference to Galatians 2 is regarding circumcision (Titus not being compelled to be circumcised in Gal 2:3-4), and visually on the page the numeral is ፫ (three horizontal strokes connected on the right, not the closed loop of ፬).

Both visually (the right leg has the horizontal 3rd-order serif of ቢ) and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez (gerundive ኀቢረነ 'having united/become one', glossed in Amharic as አንድ ሁነንም), the word is ወኀቢረነ.
